modules.title: Carry-on

domestic_economy_business.value: 1 overhead bag, 1 underseat bag and 1 personal item — 14kg (30lb) total, max 10kg (22lb) per item

domestic_dash8.value: 1 overhead bag and 1 personal item — 7kg (15lb) maximum
domestic_dash8.notes: QantasLink Dash 8 – Q400 services. Small wheelie bags don’t fit overhead on this aircraft and are gate-checked.

international_economy.value: 1 overhead bag and 1 personal item — 7kg (15lb) maximum

international_premium.value: 1 overhead bag, 1 underseat bag and 1 personal item — 14kg (30lb) total, max 10kg (22lb) per item

india_economy.notes: All flights departing India. Additional personal items are not permitted on these flights.

india_business.notes: All flights departing India. Additional personal items are not permitted on these flights.

modules.lede: Allowance depends on route and cabin. Figures below are for Qantas-operated flights; Jetstar-operated and partner-airline services can differ and are not yet covered here.

table.caption: Carry-on allowance by route and cabin

modules.title: Checked baggage

economy_domestic.notes: The source lists three exceptions to this row — Dash 8 services, Lord Howe Island, and Christmas and Cocos (Keeling) Islands. Dash 8 and Lord Howe are sourced below as separate fields; a figure for Christmas/Cocos was not in this capture and is not represented here.

economy_americas.notes: Qantas-operated flights, North and South America.

economy_row.notes: Qantas-operated flights, rest of the world.

premium_economy_row.value: 2 pieces, up to 40kg (88lb) total — no single piece over 32kg (70lb)

business_row.value: 2 pieces, up to 40kg (88lb) total — no single piece over 32kg (70lb)

first_domestic.notes: Qantas First does not operate on Australian domestic routes.

first_row.value: Up to 50kg (110lb) total — no single piece over 32kg (70lb). The source does not state a piece count for this row, unlike the others.

max_single_piece_weight.value: No single piece can exceed 32kg (70lb), regardless of your total baggage allowance.
max_single_piece_weight.notes: Applies across every cabin and region in the table above.

total_purchased_cap.value: Your checked baggage allowance, plus any additional baggage purchased, can't exceed 65kg (143lb) per person.

dash8_domestic_exception.value: Only one piece of baggage to 23kg (50lb) can be taken on Dash 8 flights, due to weight restrictions.
dash8_domestic_exception.notes: Exception to the Economy Australian-domestic row.

lord_howe_exception.value: Two pieces, combined total up to 23kg (50lb): 1st piece up to 14kg (30lb), 2nd piece up to 9kg (20lb).
lord_howe_exception.notes: Exception to the Economy Australian-domestic row, for Lord Howe Island.
